title: Complete Alchemy and Cooking Overhaul
description: Fixes inconsistencies between Last Seed and CACO's food items and recipes (cooking water, portions, jams, jerky).

title: Apothecary - Food
description: Resolves compatibility issues between Last Seed and Apothecary Food's potions and food recipes.

title: Beyond Skyrim - Bruma
description: Combines some recipes that are found in both mods.

title: Creation Club - Fishing
description: Adds boiled water as an ingredient for the soup recipes.

title: Falskaar
description: Fixes some inconsistencies with food recipes.

title: Hunterborn
description: Adds boiled water as an ingredient for the stew recipes.

title: Mealtime
description: Disables the food portioning system in Mealtime and integrates the preserved food into the skill tree.

title: Nordic Cooking
description: Fixes some inconsistencies with food recipes.

title: Requiem
description: Resolves a number of compatibility issues between Last Seed and Requiem. Note: it carries Last Seed's original third-person messages, so with it the messages are no longer first person.

title: Skyrim Alchemy and Food Overhaul
description: Resolves compatibility issues with the potions and food recipes between the two mods.

file: Skyrim Food Expanded - Last Seed Patch.esp
title: Skyrim Food Expanded
description: Fixes some inconsistencies with food recipes.

file: Last Seed - Warm Drinks Patch SE.esp
title: Warm Drinks
description: Replaces the Water item from Warm Drinks with the one from Last Seed, and makes coffee restore fatigue.

title: Less Food
description: Removes food items from containers, replacing them with spoiled food or junk. Skip it if you use a similar mod like Poverty or You Hunger. Place it at the end of your load order, after any Bashed or Smashed Patch.

file: Last Seed - Less Food Patch CACO.esp
title: Less Food - for CACO
description: Use this version of Less Food instead of the plain one if you have Complete Alchemy and Cooking Overhaul.

title: Well buckets
description: Adds buckets to the wells in Skyrim and Solstheim that can be used to collect clean water.

file: Last Seed Wells - CC Farming Patch.esp
title: Well buckets - Creation Club Farming
description: Adds a bucket to the well at Goldenhills Plantation.

file: Last Seed Wells - Hearthfire Extended Patch.esp
title: Well buckets - Hearthfire Extended
description: Adds buckets to the new wells at each Hearthfire home.

title: Well buckets - Wells in Towns
description: Adds buckets to the wells added by Wells in Towns.

title: Carriage and Ferry Travel Overhaul
description: Slower needs reduction when riding carriages and ferries.

file: Last Seed - Reliquary of a Myth Patch.esp
title: Reliquary of Myth - Artifact Overhaul
description: Fixes the compatibility issues with the Ring of Namira.
